source.kind: Wayback Machine capture of the site-internal catalog JSON (Category=2 / Subcategory=2 = Collectibles query)

source.gradeNote: Captured 2015-06-16, about 5.5 weeks before the 2015-07-23 target build. Prices are as listed then ("" price = off sale / limited reseller item; stored as null). The capture is a Collectibles query, so it contains limited items only.

notCovered: Thumbnails (t*.rbxcdn.com hashes are in the capture but not retrieved) and asset content are MISSING.
